            <div class="field field--name-field-dates-cles field--type-text-with-summary field--label-hidden field--item"><h4>To apply, please go to the OnePSL30 application platform <strong>(link </strong><a href="https://concoursens.candidature.onepsl30.fr/" target="_blank"><strong>HERE</strong></a><strong>)</strong></h4><p><span><strong>Please do not use @icloud.com email addresses, neither for you as candidate nor for the referees. </strong></span></p><p> </p><h4><span>International selection in Arts&Humanities 2027:</span></h4><ul><li><span>Application : From 16 October 2026 (14.00, Paris time) to 15 December 2026 (14.00, Paris time)</span></li><li><span>Shortlist results : From 21 January 2027</span></li><li><span>Tests : Between 15 February 2027 and 26 February 2027</span></li><li><span>Admission results : From 9 March 2027 </span></li></ul><p> </p><h4><span>International selection in Sciences 2027:</span></h4><ul><li><span>Application : From 16 October 2026 (14.00, Paris time) to 15 December 2026 (14.00, Paris time)</span></li><li><span>Shortlist results : From 27 January 2027</span></li><li><span>Tests : Between 3 March 2027 and 19 March 2027</span></li><li><span>Admission results : From 26 March 2027</span></li></ul></div>

      <div class="field field--name-field-paragraph field--type-entity-reference-revisions field--label-hidden field--items">
              <div class="field--item">  <div class="paragraph paragraph--type--simple-texte paragraph--view-mode--default">
          
      <div class="field field--name-field-paragraph field--type-text-with-summary field--label-hidden field--items">
              <div class="field--item"><h2>Presentation</h2><p>The Ecole normale supérieure - PSL aims at varying its students’ profiles and incorporates students to be enrolled in the 3rd year of bachelor (<em>licence 3</em>) or 1st year of master (<em>master 1</em>), coming from all over the world and from all disciplines. The competitive examination of the International selection is intended to young graduates in Arts & Humanities as well as Sciences, who justify at least of one year undergraduate studies in a foreign university and distinguish themselves with outstanding results.</p><p> </p><p>Joining ENS-PSL through the competitive examination of the <em>International selection</em> gives access to training of excellence, through contact with exceptional researchers, in a privileged training and research environment. Integrated to the community of the <em>normaliens</em>, international students continue their studies at ENS-PSL and at the university at the same time, while benefiting from a 1000 euros grant for 3 years and from a room on one of the ENS-PSL campuses. At the end of their studies, these students have graduated with a master degree in their speciality and with the diploma of École normale supérieure. </p><p>The examination takes place in 2 steps: a selection based upon application, then oral and written tests remotely for shortlisted candidates.</p><p> </p></div>
              <div class="field--item"><h2>Procedure</h2><ul><li>Please submit your application <a href="https://concoursens.candidature.onepsl30.fr/" target="_blank">on the OnePSL30 platform</a> before the deadline. </li><li>If the jury selects your dossier, you are invited to take written and oral tests remotely.</li><li>The marks obtained at the tests determine the list of admitted students.</li></ul></div>

              <div class="field--item">  <div class="paragraph paragraph--type--accordeon paragraph--view-mode--default">
          
            <div class="field field--name-field-titre field--type-string field--label-hidden field--item">Program and choice of academic disciplines</div>
      
            <div class="field field--name-field-corp field--type-text-with-summary field--label-hidden field--item"><p>During their 3 years of study, students from the International selection discover Paris in exceptional conditions. Above all, they benefit from the intellectual freedom and multidisciplinarity characterizing training at the ENS-PSL. Beyond the outstanding academic results expected from the candidates, ENS looks for young students driven by curiosity, open-mindedness and a taste for research. ENS-PSL is rich of the diversity of its students’ profiles, experiences and origins, and is concerned with enhancing the aptitudes of each one. For studying Arts& Humanities, we recommend you to be fluent in French. </p><p>The training begins with a welcome event (1 day) and 3 weeks of conferences and debates in Sciences and Humanities, department visits, intensive French lessons, cultural visits of Paris as well as activities and entertainments organized by the various student associations of ENS.</p><p><a href="https://www.ens.psl.eu/en/academics/academic-programs/ens-graduate-degree/ens-graduate-degree-humanities">Read more about the ENS graduate degree in Arts & Humanities</a></p><p>Academic disciplines offered through International selection in Arts&Humanities: Anthropology, Archeology, Classical studies (Greek, Latin), Cinema, Theater studies, History of Art, Musicology, Cognitive sciences, Economics, Political studies, Geography, History, History and Philosophy of Law, History and Philosophy of Sciences, Linguistics, Literature, Philosophy, Sociology.</p></div>
      
      </div>
</div>

            <div class="field field--name-field-titre field--type-string field--label-hidden field--item">Application dossier</div>
      
            <div class="field field--name-field-corp field--type-text-with-summary field--label-hidden field--item"><p><strong>Eligibility Criteria </strong></p><p>Candidates :</p><ul><li>Be no older than 25 years of age as of the application opening date (must not have turned 26)</li><li>Must not have resided in France for more than 10 months during the academic year of the competition or the preceding academic year</li><li>Must provide proof of completion of at least three years of study toward a foreign university degree. This proof must be submitted in the form of complete transcripts for all university coursework</li><li>Must not have previously applied to the SI.</li></ul><p><em>You may apply if you are currently in your 3rd year of studies. </em></p><p><em><span lang="EN-US">On rare occasions, the Director of ENS may authorise applications from candidates whose academic background is non-standard</span></em><span lang="EN-US">.</span></p><p><strong>List of documents to be submitted on the dedicated platform, in this order :</strong></p><ul><li>Curriculum vitae</li><li>Motivation letter (1 to 3 pages long, font : Times New Roman, 12 pt and 1.5 line spacing) - written in French; Candidates in Economics, Linguistics or Cognitive studies must submit their motivation letter both in French and in English</li><li>Research project of 3 pages maximum (10 000 characters including spaces).  This is not a cover letter but a research project: it should address a well-defined topic and deal with a core issue, then develop a set of arguments and provide for a few hypotheses. The material the research project relies on (e.g. fieldwork, corpus, database, archives, etc.) has to be precisely described. The research project refers to an existing scientific literature while selecting a small range of relevant and informed references.This project includes a bibliography (list of 10 books, including articles or literary works you have read and which turned out to be important in your intellectual career). It comes in addition to the study project. - written in French; Candidates in Economics, Linguistics or Cognitive studies can submit their  project either in French or in English</li><li>University transcript</li><li>High school diploma</li><li><span><strong>2 to 4 letters of recommendation. You should request letters of recommendation from your references directly through the OnePSL30 platform by entering their email addresses in the designated fields.</strong></span></li></ul><p><strong>If incomplete, your application will not be taken into consideration.</strong></p></div>
      
      </div>
</div>

            <div class="field field--name-field-corp field--type-text-with-summary field--label-hidden field--item"><p>There is no specific reading programme. After the pre-selection, the board of examiners conceives tests in order to evaluate candidates’ abilities to analyse, conceptualise and synthesise information. They also assess the scientific or literary culture and intellectual curiosity of candidates as well as the relevance of their projects.</p><p>The 3 exams are:</p><ul><li>A written exam in French, related to the candidate’s discipline - <a href="/sites/default/files/sil-duree-epreuves-2023.pdf">Duration: see here </a>- Weight 1.</li><li>An oral exam in front of a panel of the candidate’s discipline - <a href="/sites/default/files/sil-duree-epreuves-2023.pdf">Duration: see here</a> - Weight 2. Warning: the duration in the candidate's discipline might change from year to year.</li><li>An interview about both the candidate’s academic background and project, in front of a single panel for all candidates - Duration: 20 to 30' - Weight 2.</li></ul><p>The regulations for distance tests are available for consultation <a href="/sites/default/files/epreuves-reglement_-2023.pdf">HERE.</a></p><p>Both the oral exam and the interview are conducted in French. The candidate may use English.These exams will be organised as distance exams. They will be detailed later on our Web page</p><p>Disciplines proposed are : Anthropology, Archeology, Classical studies (Greek, Latin), Cinema, Theater studies, History of Art, Musicology, Cognitive studies, Economy, Political studies, geograph, History, History and Philosophy of Law, History and Philosophy of Sciences, Linguistic, Literature, Philosophy, Sociology.</p><p><strong>Dictionaries or any personal document are forbidden.</strong></p><p> </p></div>

            <div class="field field--name-field-corp field--type-text-with-summary field--label-hidden field--item"><p>Students from the International selection are driven by curiosity, open-mindedness and a taste for research and innovation.
